description: Defines an abstract base class 'AbstractScraper' for scraping recipe data from web pages, including methods for retrieving recipe details, handling plugins, and parsing HTML content.

classes.name: AbstractScraper
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for scraping recipe data from HTML pages, with methods to extract various recipe attributes and handle plugins.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the scraper with HTML content, URL, and optional image selection setting; sets up BeautifulSoup, OpenGraph, SchemaOrg, and plugin hooks.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Abstract method to get the recipe author.

methods.name: canonical_url
methods.description: Returns the canonical URL of the recipe, resolving relative links.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Abstract method to get the website name.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Abstract method to get the host domain.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Detects and returns the language of the recipe page.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Abstract method to get the recipe title.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Abstract method to get the list of ingredients.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients into categories with purposes.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe instructions.

methods.name: instructions_list
methods.description: Splits instructions into a list of steps.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe category.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Abstract method to get total servings or items.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe description.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Abstract method to get total time in minutes.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Abstract method to get cooking time.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Abstract method to get preparation time.

methods.name: cuisine
methods.description: Abstract method to get cuisine type.

methods.name: cooking_method
methods.description: Abstract method to get cooking method.

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe ratings.

methods.name: ratings_count
methods.description: Abstract method to get number of ratings.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Abstract method to get required equipment.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Abstract method to get nutrient info.

methods.name: dietary_restrictions
methods.description: Abstract method for dietary restrictions.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe image URL.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Abstract method to get recipe keywords.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Finds and returns all valid links in the page.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the recipe data into JSON format.
